# Murray Home Improvement

> Owner-operated, licensed and insured remodeling and building contractor based in Chelmsford, Massachusetts. Owner Eric Murray (Massachusetts Construction Supervisor License CSL #077319, Home Improvement Contractor registration HIC #174394) has more than 30 years of residential remodeling experience and is on every job himself. Free, itemized estimates: (978) 479-9406.

- Service area: Chelmsford, MA — including North, South, East and West Chelmsford and Chelmsford Center — and the five towns that border it: Lowell, Westford, Tyngsborough, Billerica and Carlisle.
- Work: kitchens, bathrooms, home additions and second-story additions, basement finishing, decks and porches, siding and exterior remodeling, roofing, windows and doors, and custom carpentry — frame to finish.
- Contact: (978) 479-9406 (call or text) · eric@murrayhomeimprovement.com · [free estimate request](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/free-estimate.html)

## Services

- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/kitchen-remodeling.html): Custom kitchens built around how you actually cook and gather.

- [Home Additions](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/home-additions.html): More space, built to match — additions that look original to the home.
- [Second-Story Additions](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/second-story-additions.html): Add a whole level without losing your yard.
- [Basement Finishing](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/basement-finishing.html): Turn unused square footage into real living space.
- [Decks & Porches](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/decks-porches.html): Outdoor living built to last New England seasons.
- [Siding & Exterior Remodeling](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/siding-exterior-remodeling.html): Fresh siding, trim, and curb appeal that transforms a home.
- [Roofing](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/roofing.html): Roofs that protect everything beneath them.
- [Windows & Doors](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/windows-doors.html): Tighter, brighter, quieter — and a better-looking home.
- [Custom Carpentry](https://www.murrayhomeimprovement.com/services/custom-carpentry.html): Frame to finish — the craftsmanship behind every project.
